I don't have anything on Telltale. The stored knowledge covers only Joad Axle Works (matter C-2) and general firm practice, so I can't say what Telltale instructed on expert report review or settlement timing. If Telltale is another client, its instructions are confidential to that engagement and shouldn't be used as a template for Joad without proper clearance. Joad's own instructions are the right basis for its approach.

**Experts (Joad)**
- Joad wants to review the names and credentials of all proposed testifying experts before engagement. Get its approval before engaging anyone.
- Joad prefers design testimony to stay focused on the product at issue. It offered to help identify candidates with standards-body experience.
- The firm should be ready with several candidates per discipline, including credentials and prior testimony. Before engaging anyone a memo recommends, confirm the client discussion has happened.
- Nothing in the file addresses how Joad wants expert reports reviewed, such as draft review, turnaround times or who sees them. Raise that with Evander Thorsby at the start. If testing is involved, Joad requires at least ten days' notice and wants quotes before testing is commissioned. It also wants a tight circle around who sees test files.

**Settlement timing (Joad)**
- Settlement above the insurer's pre-approved tier needs written board sign-off. Verbal indications from directors or officers are not enough.
- Joad needs about three weeks to prepare a board consent, so flag the lead time early.
- No offer above the already-approved authority may be made or communicated, even as a signal, until written board sign-off is in hand.
- For any offer within the insurer's tier, check with Thorsby before conveying it, because the insurer will want to be involved. Copy Perpetua Wallace on anything bearing on coverage.
- The firm's usual sequence is to assess the claim, then send the client an assessment and recommended range, and wait for authority before any offer.

If you can point me to Telltale's instructions, or confirm they may be used, I can compare them against Joad's requirements.
